text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Judicial power is investigating if Liano acted against the costitution in Sogecable's issue.
- The government gives more money to Catalan CiU to finance health system.
- (Economy Minister) Rato says now that PSOE has stolen evidence of "fiscal amnesty" from the Tax department.
- PSOE's Guerra said he will divide the political party if left out of group of leaders.
- Writer Umberto Eco, was given honoris causa in La Mancha
EL MUNDO
- (Economy Minister) Rato says previous government mislead him after the handover of power.
- Bullfighter Joselito left bullring through the infirmary door.
- (PSOE's) Guerra says he won't remain in the Executive if he is not deputy secretary.
- Basque ETA's ideologist offered to stop violence if the right to self dermination is given to his region.
- Aznar reiterated he intends to rule until the natural election in 2000, and gave his backing to spokesman Rodriguez.
ABC
- Judge asks Civil Guard to investigate socialist firms' accounts.
CINCO DIAS
- The markets in ecstasy
- An improvement in tax revenues moves ahead the fear of a mini-budget.
- Meat firms accused Agricultural officials to be responsible for the rise in pork meat prices.
- Santander's vice president Martias Rodriguez Inciarte said the fall in banking margins reaches low
EXPANSION
- Stocks climbed above 560
- Spanish Treasury boosted debt market innovation with the new instrument of STRIPS.
- High Court gave its approval to "flexible dismissals" agreed in the labour reform pact
- (Prime Minister) Aznar said the OECD is confirming good economic trend in Spain
- After interest rates decline, Union Fenosa will reduce its expenditure by 21 billion pesetas.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Buying activity from private and investment funds pushed stocks above 560
- Water reform will imply the introduction of tariffs for final users
- Downward revision of 1997 inflation target at 2.2 percent will not affect pension revaluation (already approved with the old 2.6 percent goal)
- Tabacalera will make its bid in the privatisation of Morocco's tobacco.
-- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
